page_note: 该页为OECD《Employment Outlook 2024》第245页，正文两段外含单幅折线图Figure 5.6，展示五个国家家庭消费排放按排放分位数的分布，并附注释、来源与StatLink链接。

heading.title: Emissions from household consumption are very unequal across and within countries
heading.subtitle: Emissions from household consumption, tCO2 per household at different points in the national emissions distribution

figures.source_line: Source: OECD calculations using IEA emissions factors for different fuels, World Input-Output Database (WIOD) as well as household budget surveys (2015 for EU countries, 2016 for Mexico, 2019 for Türkiye).

components.evidence: grey legend strip with France, Germany, Mexico, Poland, Türkiye sits between subtitle and plot area
the plot area itself is filled light grey behind the five lines
small print below plot: "Note: Average emissions across the national emissions distribution..." and "Source: OECD calculations..."
"StatLink" glyph with "https://stat.link/snwjx0" under the source line
subtitle reads "tCO2 per household at different points in the national emissions distribution"; axis shows bare 0–25
"Tonne of CO2 per household" printed above the top tick "25"

new_components.name: category_axis_title_at_axis_end
new_components.evidence: "Emissions decile" printed below the right end of the x tick row, not centred under the plot
new_components.why_it_matters: 分位数轴的名称只在轴右端出现一次，表格若不带此标签，1–10这些纯数字刻度无法说明其含义。

new_components.name: subscript_unit_glyph
new_components.evidence: unit written with subscript 2: "Tonne of CO2 per household" and "tCO2" in subtitle
new_components.why_it_matters: 解析后可能变成"tCO 2"或"tCO2"，单位字符串匹配会失败，影响用单位定位数值。

new_components.name: duplicated_unit_text
new_components.evidence: unit appears twice: "tCO2 per household" in subtitle and "Tonne of CO2 per household" above axis
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一单位有两种写法，抽取时需判断以哪一处为准，否则表头单位与图不一致。

difficulty_notes: 纵轴0–25每5个单位一格（约26像素/格，即约0.19 tCO2/像素），且图上没有任何数值标签。要在5%容差内命中0.2这个点，允许误差仅±0.01 tCO2，相当于不到十分之一像素；Mexico与Türkiye两条线在1–8分位几乎重合在基线上，连区分两条线都困难。即便是21.0这样的大值，5%容差为±1.05，尚在半格以内可读，但十个待查值中有四个落在0.2–3.8区间，读值精度成为主要瓶颈；标签方面只需"国家名+分位数"两个键，反而不难。
